Set features and their limits for a plan. If a feature already exists in the plan, its limit will be updated. New features will be added. Use feature keys (e.g., "daily_profile_view") instead of UUIDs.

**Additional fields:**
- `resetPeriod` for COUNTER features (`daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|never`)
- `tierValue` for TIER features (e.g., `medium`, `high`, `expert_managed`)
- send `null` to clear `resetPeriod` or `tierValue` when needed

**Limit values:**
- `-1` = Unlimited access (no quota)
- `0` = Feature disabled (blocked)
- `> 0` = Fixed quota (e.g., 10 = user can use this feature 10 times)
